title: Second moment of the standardized sign
statement: Let $0<p<1$, and choose a sign $X\in\{-1,1\}$ according to the probability distribution with mean $1-2p$. Write $\sigma=\sqrt{4p(1-p)}$ and $Z=(X-(1-2p))/\sigma$. Then the expected value of $Z^2$ is $1$.
